stories.title: Commanders QB Daniels dislocates elbow, set for more tests
stories.summary: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels was carted off the field in Sunday's game against the Cowboys after dislocating his left elbow on the final play of the first half.

stories.title: Bears QB Williams in 'good spirits' despite injuring hamstring
stories.summary: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams exited Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings because of a right hamstring injury.

stories.title: Nashville turf temp of 157 F melts cleats, sends Sirianni for IV
stories.summary: Players' cleats were melting and Eagles coach Nick Sirianni needed an IV as a result of extreme heat conditions at Nissan Stadium during Sunday's game between Philadelphia and the Tennessee Titans, a 24-20 win for the Eagles.

stories.title: Hurts taunts Titans after Eagles win: Finished what you started
stories.summary: Tennessee Titans defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons approached Jalen Hurts for a postgame dap-up following Philadelphia's 24-20 come-from-behind win Sunday and the Eagles' quarterback was ready for him.

stories.title: Sources: Ole Miss RB Lacy (shoulder) not expected to be out long term
stories.summary: The left shoulder injury that sidelined Ole Miss star running back Kewan Lacy during Saturday night's win over LSU is not expected to keep him out long term, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel.
